page.overview:
Who is Kathy Long?

Kathy Long was meant to appear in Mortal Kombat II but in the end, she was dropped due to time constraints.

This female fighter was based on a real life kickboxer called [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kathy_Long Kathy Long], whom John Tobias admired and thought to be a noble person.
